               Table "public.events_2024"
   Column    |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default 
-------------+---------+-----------+----------+---------
 id          | integer |           | not null | 
 customer_id | integer |           |          | 
 at          | date    |           | not null | 
Partition of: events FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2025-01-01')
Foreign-key constraints:
    TABLE "events" CONSTRAINT "events_customer_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES app.customers(id)
Triggers:
